comparison_rule: Each portfolio row includes absolute pre-tax capital/path results and matched lifts to B167/B170 where exact support and funding permit, strongest standalone on its exact support, and equal-weight same sleeves.
component_rule: BJ145 is an allocation-engine contract only; it cannot create a new Stage-4 selector or overwrite a retained complete pipeline tuple.

excluded_source_records.reason: the Gate-A sparse selector/direction records do not include an accepted complete ticket-construction trace on the #192 common calendar; terminal return is not used as an eligibility reason

the accepted interface package records action compatibility but does not provide an immutable per-issue executable ticket/tax-lot trace for one fixed Stage-1→3 sleeve; terminal return is not used as an eligibility reason

higher_order_rule: all nonempty subsets of the H1 panel; all nonempty subsets of each robust-shortlist row after prior-only M selection; no post-outcome membership choice
m_curve_and_path_tables: for each family publish the full frozen M curve, fixed-M comparator, strictly-prior selected-M path, and nested-LOYO selected-M path, separately for each deployment seed path.
materialization_rule: Gate B materializes every eligible candidate's frozen M curve and strictly-prior M-selection path, then enumerates all pairs across the subsets. Higher-order combinations are exhaustive for the preregistered robust shortlist and descriptive elsewhere; no outcome-ranked source cell may enter after Gate A.
portfolio_k_saturation: for every ordered robust shortlist, publish K=1..len(shortlist) equal-weight and each prior-only allocator path; report marginal candidate-minus-K-1 capital, risk, covariance, HHI and retained-cash changes. K is never selected by same-window outcomes.
screening_rule: The full materialized frontier is retrospective/descriptive. Raw rank, raw Pareto membership or a best descriptive cell cannot be reported as Edge; a positive same-window result is hypothesis-generating and needs genuinely held-out/forward validation before any ladder review.
